text.p: A hat-trick by Bruno Labbadia helped Werder Bremen to a 5-1 win over Bochum in the German first division on Friday.
It was Bochum's first defeat since gaining promotion last season.
Marco Bode and Austrian international midfielder Andreas Herzog were already on the scoresheet when Labbadia scored his opening goal in the 38th minute for the rampant home side.
Eleven minutes into the second half he tucked home his second from close range and in the 68th minute he jinked around his marker Thomas Reis to score his third.
Midfielder Karsten Hutwelker netted a consolation goal for Bochum five minutes from time.
The win lifted Bremen four places to fourth in the Bundesliga. In the night's only other match, Fortuna Duesseldorf lost 2-0 at home to Hansa Rostock.
